prerequisites: Knowledge of basics in the field of product modeling in CAD systems
technologies of mechanical processing of their components

learning_outcomes.text: The student is able to discuss the subsequent phases and tasks of the project life cycle. He can create technical documentation for individual project tasks. The student knows what computer programs can be used to support the creation of individual elements of documentation.

The student is able to create a project team, organize the work of the team and manage it efficiently. In particular: define roles in the project, set competences, tasks and set goals and division of work. The student has the skills to create a plan of any construction or technological project.

The student is aware of the need for lifelong learning, improving professional, personal and social competences resulting from the changing reality and the variety of projects. The student is ready to start work related to design.
The student is able to develop the technological process of typical mechanical parts.
The student is able to find information from various sources necessary to solve the problems presented in the project.

syllabus_topics: Introduction and explanation of the meaning of the CDIO initiative
Building team members' engagement in stationary and remote work
Tools for creating space for online teamwork
Ways to build active communication, conduct discussions and presentations online
Design stages: adopting a team project plan
determining the necessary resources and how to obtain them
Designing in accordance with the principles of the design thinking method: empathy
assessment_rules: The passing threshold for the project is 60.0%. The project constitutes 100% of the final grade.

degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
